account_or_program: Darwinex Zero / DarwinIA SILVER and GOLD

official_sources.title: How does the risk engine work?

official_rules.description: The DARWIN risk engine targets a monthly VaR range rather than reproducing the signal account risk one-for-one.
The Risk Engine may adjust open positions to remain within duration-specific D-Leverage limits.
Strategy VaR uses recent exposed days and target VaR uses up to six months of history while tolerating a maximum-to-minimum VaR ratio of two.
A DarwinIA SILVER rating of at least 75 guarantees an allocation under the published program rules.
The published SILVER rating weights current return, cumulative six-month return, and six-month maximum drawdown.
SILVER applies stricter correlation eligibility between DARWINs belonging to the same user.
A DARWIN must have opened a trade in the current or previous month to participate in SILVER.
GOLD requires more than eight months of signal history and one published return threshold together with Return/Drawdown above 2.5.
GOLD ranking is ordered by current calendar-month return among eligible DARWINs.

internal_guardrails.description: QuantMechanica treats a five-percent daily loss as an internal account-protection boundary.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Preserves the existing OWNER risk mandate while explicitly avoiding an unsupported claim that it is a public Darwinex Zero rule.

internal_guardrails.description: QuantMechanica treats a twenty-percent total loss as an internal account-protection boundary.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Keeps the standing OWNER boundary operationally visible without mixing it into official provider rules.

internal_guardrails.description: No EA, strategy, symbol, or single idea may risk more than one percent per trade.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Bounds concentration independently of the Darwinex Risk Engine and remains the standing universal OWNER cap.

internal_guardrails.description: Cap simultaneous planned stop risk within a correlated symbol or mechanism cluster.
internal_guardrails.rationale: A per-sleeve cap does not control several nominally different sleeves expressing the same market risk.

internal_guardrails.description: Cap simultaneous planned account stop risk across all open sleeves.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Controls concurrent exposure rather than relying on the sum of static sleeve allocations or historical non-overlap.

internal_guardrails.description: Require the estimated 99.9th-percentile one-day loss to remain below two percent.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Creates distance to the internal daily guardrail using a synchronized mark-to-market book distribution.

internal_guardrails.description: Require the 95th-percentile six-month maximum drawdown estimate to remain below eight percent.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Aligns book construction with the six-month SILVER horizon and GOLD Return/Drawdown objective.

internal_guardrails.description: Keep rolling strategy VaR substantially more stable than the provider's published two-to-one tolerance.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Stable underlying risk improves faithful DARWIN replication and avoids treating raw account scaling as free return.

internal_guardrails.description: Freeze weights within a calendar month and cap deliberate month-to-month turnover.
internal_guardrails.rationale: Avoids destabilizing the Risk Engine input and reduces adaptive selection on recent returns.

compensation_requirements: evidence debt remains visible in the signed book dossier
minimum-weight forward probation with actual DARWIN metrics
no universal hard-block dimension is present

evaluation_profile.objective: Maximize expected six-month DARWIN return while preserving stable Risk Engine mapping, low six-month drawdown, and eligibility for DarwinIA SILVER and GOLD.

metrics.description: Rolling six-month return on the DARWIN-replica basis, not only raw signal-account PnL.
Rolling maximum drawdown over the SILVER rating horizon.
Return-to-drawdown ratio used as a GOLD eligibility objective.
Faithfulness and stability of the underlying-to-DARWIN risk mapping.

go_criteria.description: Every sleeve and book result is bound to exact source, include, EX5, set, history, calendar, cost-model, and rulepack hashes.
The exact proposed book passes a sealed synchronized mark-to-market outer validation with all internal risk budgets enforced.
The decision package reports both raw signal-account and DARWIN-replica metrics including risk-engine intervention sensitivity.
New or soft-evidence sleeves start at minimum weight with a documented forward probation review.
No deployment or risk change follows from this rulepack without a separate signed OWNER manifest decision.

notes: This file is an additive research contract and is not consumed by farmctl, an EA, a terminal, or a deployment script.
The current live DXZ state must be read from its signed manifest and live evidence before any future integration.
Official provider facts must be refreshed and version-bumped when Darwinex publishes a material change.
